name: sportz-fullstack
description: Sportz - Full-stack real-time match data app (frontend + backend)

scripts.build: cd sportz-frontend-main && npm install && npm run build && cd ../webSocketProject && npm install
scripts.install:all: cd webSocketProject && npm install && cd ../sportz-frontend-main && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
